title: Finding a bit of each season

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Give seasonal change a consistent narrative form so new ingredients feel like chapters in the same story.
strategic_value: Repeating the phrase and changing the produce can make Sweetgreen’s seasonal offer recognizable over time.
demonstration: Four animated scenes pair spring peas, summer watermelon, autumn produce and winter squash with small outlined people and variations of Finding a bit of the season.
practical_value: Retain a verbal pattern while letting illustration and type placement respond to each seasonal subject.

content_islands.name: Seasonal words
content_islands.spec: Position the repeated phrase around each central illustration, changing the season name.

content_islands.name: Illustrated action
content_islands.spec: Give the person a different physical relationship to each oversized ingredient.

reference_purposes.Expression: The complete clip changes produce, small character actions and text arrangement across four seasons.
reference_purposes.Application: The same campaign phrase is applied to spring, summer, autumn and winter.
